tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gnas lugs gsal byed ye shes sgron me bzhugs so// "$

༄༅// na mo ratna gu ru/ kun gzhi mtha' bral chos kyi sku// longs sku 'gag med sprin tshogs kyis// thugs rje rol pa'i char rgyun 'bebs// skal ldan myu gu sbyin mdzad pa'i// rdo rje 'chang sogs bla ma rnams// gcig tu rtogs pa'i mos gus kyis// 'bral med gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// skye med ngang la 'bral med kyang*// gus pa'i dbang gis gsol 'debs nas// bdag sogs 'gro drug sems can rnams// 'gag med thugs rjes bzung du gsol// thub pa'i bstan pa rtsod ldan la// 'khor 'das shan thang 'byed pa'i dus// dpag med bde sdug bsgrub pa'i dus// smon lam 'bras bu bsgrub pa'i dus// rnyed dka' dal 'byor rnyed pa'i dus// skal ldan lam sna zin pa'i dus// theg chen bstan pa dar ba'i dus// tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i dus// skal ldan rnams kyi snang ba la// sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan yang*// ma bcos lhun grub rang rig sems// ma dag rnams kyi snang ba la// nyon mongs dug lnga shin tu rags// skal med lam la log pa'i dus// rgyu 'bras rtsing por spyod pa'i dus// bsgrub pa phye dus byed pa'i dus// sgom chen bsogs 'jog brtson pa'i dus// gzung 'dzin sred pa rags pa'i dus// rgyu 'bras dkar nag smin pa'i dus// ye shes lnga dang nyon mongs lnga// shin tu rags pas rab tu rtsod// de phyir rtsod ldan zhes su btags// deng sang rtsod ldan 'bad pa'i dus// sems 'khor 'das gnyis kyi tshong 'dus la// rig pa dngos med tshong dpon gyis// rlung sems gnyis kyi rta pho la// dal 'byor mi lus rin chen de// blang dor gnyis kyi sha thag la// tshong nor dal 'byor rin chen btags// rig pa dngos med tshong dpon gyis// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi tshong 'dus la// tshong 'khor 'das bde sdug bdam kha yod// res 'ga' ngan song gi gnas su nyul// res 'ga' mtho ris gnas su nyul// res 'ga' sangs rgyas dgongs pa nyul// dal 'byor mi lus 'tshong la khad// la la ngan song sdug bsngal nyo// la la sangs rgyas dgongs pa nyo// deng sang 'khor 'das tshong 'dus la// tshong bdam kha rang la yod pa'i dus// dal 'byor mi lus rin chen de// tshong pham par ma byed skal ldan rnams// tshong bdam kha ma nor skal ldan rnams// 'khor ba dpag med sdug bsngal 'di// de sngon myong ba a tsa ma// dus da lta dran kyang glo snying 'dar// de la soms cig skal ldan rnams// bka' rgyud bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bde chen gyi lam sna zin pa'i dus// sdug bsngal la phyi bltas mi mdzad zhu// 'khor ba khyim thabs sdug bsngal 'di// spu gri kha'i sbrang rtsi bzhin// bde ba yun thung sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab// me dpung nang gi sa bon la// gtan bde'i myu gu 'byung bar dka'// bu smad khyim thabs spangs na yang*// gzung 'dzin khyim thabs ma spangs na// mi grol bas na 'khor ba yin// sangs rgyas bstan pa nam mkha' la// thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs med shar// las can gyi ma rig mun pa sel// khyed thugs rje nyi ma bde ba'i dus// sdug bsngal gyi mun khung ci zhig bya// 'khor ba phyi bltas mi mdzad zhu// 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di// gting mtha' zab cing rba rlabs che// 'chi bdag gi chu srin myur mgyogs che// 'dod yon gyi nor bu chog shes med// khyed byang chub kyi skam sar phyin pa'i dus// chags sems kyis phyi ltas mi mdzad zhu// 'bros pa long yod kyis ma bslu bar// g.yel med mgo la me shor bzhin// 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho las// da res thar na thar nges yin// dpag med kyi sdug bsngal da res bzhag

/bde chen gyi skam sar phyin pa'i dus// yang yang mi rtag dran pa gces// khyed 'chi ba mi rtag mi dran na// nga gzhon no snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang*// long yod snyam pa'i g.yeng g.yeng nas// khyed mdza' bshes kyi kha la nyan nyan nas// 'phya dogs kyi mi ngo bsrungs bsrungs nas// lto rgyab kyi zhen pa bsgrubs bsgrubs nas// 'dod yon gyi rjes phyir 'brangs 'brang nas// glo bur rkyen kha 'drims 'drims nas// tshogs drug yul phyir 'brang 'brangs nas// da bya sang byas khyer khyer nas// nyon mongs kyi dbang du song song nas// g.yeng ba bdud kyis khyer khyer nas// 'dod sred zhen pa phugs su bcug /ngo bsrung gi thun bu btu btu nas// khyed ri khrod dgon pa bsten na yang*// bsogs 'jog khe skyed brtsi brtsi nas// brting med lkog nyal byed byed nas// khyed byang chub kyi skam sar phyin pa'i dus// rgyal bu btson dong nang na shor ba bzhin// yengs med thabs kyis ma 'bros na// skal med gong bzhin g.yeng g.yeng nas// sang 'chi bdag chu srin 'ong ba'i dus// bsogs 'jog nor gyis bslu thabs med// 'dzangs pas tshig gis bri thabs med// sdar mas wa 'bros byed thabs med// dpa' bos ral kha 'gyed sa med// phan pos rkang grangs brtsis sa med// btsan po'i mkhar la 'bros sa med// gces pas yus bdo byed sa med// 'khor g.yogs mang yang khrid sa med// thabs rnams sna tshogs du ma yis// skad cig tsam kyang bshol thabs med// skyabs med gcig pur 'gro ba'i dus// thabs zad blo rdug 'byung ba'i dus// skal med de dus 'gyod da re// le lo can gyi mdun ma 'phyis// sdug bsngal gyi rba rlabs 'byung ba'i tshe// las ngan spyod pa blo re nor// sdug bsngal khrag gi rgya mtsho yi// gting la thug pa a tsa ma// sdug bsngal rtsa ba rang la byung*// skad cig yus bdo byed sa med// yus bdo byed na su la byed// e ma sems can snying re rje// don de la soms dang skal ldan tsho// yang yang soms dang skal ldan rnams// thar pa'i sgrub rten mi lus 'di// thob par dka'o skal ldan rnams// nyams len snyan rgyud gdams ngag 'di// tshig tshogs snyan ngag ma lta bar// don rang gi sems la zhu gtugs mdzod// deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'di la// gzung 'dzin chags sdang rags pa'i dus// 'jig rten bya ba btang ba dka'// mtshan ldan bla ma bsten pa dkon// bla ma dam pa bsten dus su// dpon slob rten 'brel 'dzom pa'i dus// bla ma mnyes pa'i rdzas brgyad la// bsgrub pa'i bsnyen bkur mchog tu 'gyur// bsgrub pa'i bsnyen bkur ma thengs par// yon tan rgyud la skye ba dkon// yon tan rgyud la ma skyes na// 'grogs yun ring bas ci la phan// tshar thul lta bu'i dad pa bzhin// gus med yun 'grogs ci zhig bya// rang sems sangs rgyas ma mthong bar// bla ma sangs rgyas zer na yang*// bcos ma gzhan gyi lad mo tsam// dad pa des kyang rkyen mi thub// rang la skyon yon ci tsam par// gzhan gyi skyon yon mthong gyur na// rgyu 'bras yin pas dus mtshungs shar// yon tan yid bzhin nor bu de// ma bsgrub bar du mthong bar dka'// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'bras bu de// ma bsgrub bar du mi rnyed pas// dper na sa bon ma btab rmo rko de// ston thog 'bru ni yid smon yin// ma bsgrubs sangs rgyas de bzhin no// de'i lung ni rdzogs chen las// ma bsgrubs sangs rgyas thob pa ni// rdo rje sems dpas ma gsungs so// de skad ces ni gsungs pa'i phyir// ma smin gzhan rgyud bkrol mi 'gyur// gzhan rgyud bkrol bar ma gyur na// rgya mtsho chu thigs phri ba bzhin// gcig pu'i zhi bde ci zhig bya// de phyir rang gzhan smin grol la// rang sems dpang btsug gi bsgrub pa gces// bsgrub pa'i gnas ni gang zhe na// bka' brgyud bla ma thams cad kyis// ri khrod dgon pa rab tu bsngags// ri khrod dgon pa ma bsten par// g.yeng ba'i lam la byang chub dka'// khyed ri khrod 'grim pa ngo mtshar che// gnas lug bsgom pa rjes yid rangs// deng sang spyod pa 'di 'dra bas// yengs pa med pa'i brtson 'grus dang*// mngon lkog med pa'i dam tshig dang*// kha gsag med pa'i gdung sems dang*// btang klod med pa'i mos gus dang*// dka' spyad bsgrub pa 'di 'dra ba// pha bka' brgyud rnams kyi spyod yul yin// pha blas bu yis byed pa yin// khe grags kyi dri mas ma gos pa// snying nas byang chub don gnyer gyis// 'di bzhin rtag tu bsgrubs gyur nas// yon tan gyi zla ba tshes par nges// 'tsho ba shugs la 'ong bar nges// dgon par rang dbang thob par nges// sbyangs pa'i las 'phro sad par nges// pha bka' brgyud kyi thugs rjes bzung bar nges// yid dam gyi byin brlabs 'jug par nges// mkha' 'gros dngos grub ster bar nges// chos skyong gi bar chad bsal bar nges// dal 'byor gyi ston thog bcad par nges// gtan gyi phyi srid tshar bar nges// rkyen ngan grogs su shar bar nges// yon tan phyogs med shar bar nges// 'gro don phyogs med 'byung bar nges// pha rjes bu yis slebs par nges// de ltar mdzod dang skal ldan kun// khyed ri khrod 'grim pa'i sgom chen rnams// ri khrod 'grims lugs rnam pa gsum// rab dang 'bring dang tha ma gsum// tha ma'i ri khrod 'grim pa ni// de'i sems ni 'di ltar bskyed// bdag nyid gcig pu zhi bde dang*// bla ma rnams kyi ngo bsrungs dang*// gong ma rnams la 'gran sems dang*// 'og ma rnams la khyad gsod dang*// gzhan ma rnams la khe grags dang*// 'di la cung zhig bsran pa ni// grags pa snyan pa thob nas ni// sems can kun gyis bkur ba'i zhing*// 'gyur ram snyam pa'i sems bskyed de// 'dod pa'i dug gis 'dod pa bkag

/grags pa snyan pa des mi thob// 'bras med phub ma brdung ba bzhin// sgom pa nyams su len dus su// skad cig tsam gyi thun sgom la// yang na dran pa'i rlung 'tshubs ldang*// yang na bying rmugs gi dbang du 'gro// rig pa dngas snyigs mi 'byed cing*// rig pa gsal stong ting 'dzin med// mchog thun mong dngos grub des mi thob// 'chi ba mi rtag dran pa med// dge sbyor las kyi go rim med// bzlas brjod grangs dang dam bca' med// nyams len rang sems dpang po med// gtan gyi bde ba des mi thob// dgon pa lus la tshong dus sems// bag med nyal dang gnyid la dga'// don med las la brtsi bldab mang*// don yod nyams len yal bar dor// bogs 'don nges shes des mi thob// yid btags bar chad byed pa'i dus// ltogs shing bza' btung dran pa mang*// lto rgyab zhen pa sngar bas che// yang yang 'bad de brtson na yang*// nyams myong nges shes yal nas 'gro// ri khrod gnas la skyo ba skyes// bsen mos bar chad byed pa'i tshe// nyon mongs bag chags yang yang ldang*// bde ba lam khyer des mi shes// bdud kyi ngos 'dzin des mi shes// ri khrod dgon pa 'grim pa'i tshe// lo zla mi brtsi zhing grangs brtsi// yon tan mi brtsi 'tsho ba brtsi// bla med byang chub ma thob par// 'dug yun ring bas ci la phan// rang don khongs su ma chud pas// gzhan gyi phye gtor ci zhig bya// rang sems sgyu med mi spyod par// gzhan gyis mthong na cog ge ba// lkog tu bya byed su bas mang*// don med tshul chos ci zhig bya// gdeng med lkog nyal 'dug snying can// bag chags sgrib pa mi dag pas// tha mal bas kyang khyed mi 'phags// don med gcig 'dug ci zhig bya// bsgrub pa 'di yang gal che ste// bsgrub pa'i cha rkyen zang zing dgos// snyam nas 'dod yon rjes su 'brangs// zang zing bsogs 'jog chog shes med// nyams len bsgrub pa phyi dus byed// sngar ri khrod 'grim pa dmus pa 'dra// de tshe bdud kyis zin pa yin// tha ma'i ri khrod 'grims lugs yin// de ltar ma mdzad sgom chen rnams// tha ma'i mdzad spyod pa spangs nas ni// 'di bzhin mdzad na don yod pas// 'chi ba mi rtag rgyud bskul zhing*// 'jig rten bya ba phyal gyi dor// byang chub sems kyi rgyud sbyangs zhing*// rang lus gsal stong bskyed rim bsgoms// bka' brgyud bla ma spyi bor bkur// sems skye med blo 'das ngang du sbyang*// dge rtsa sems can don du bsngo// 'di ltar tshul bzhin nyams blangs shing*// 'bring gi ri khrod 'grims lugs ni// phyi ma don du gnyer ba yis// bya ba btang ba'i rnal 'byor pa// tshe gcig sangs rgyas don gnyer gyis// snyan rgyud gdam ngag bdud rtsi de// bsgrub pa'i gnas ni gang zhe na// grub thob zhabs kyis bcag pa'i gnas// ri'i rtse'am lung gsum mdo// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas// nyams nga bag tsha med pa yi// shin tu dben zhing nyams dga' gnas// rtse cig sems kyi bsgrub pa la// gcig pur bsgrub la mnyam par zhog

/grogs kyi zhen pa spang bar bya// phyi la chags shing zhen pa'i dus// rmi lam dang ni sgyu ma bzhin// dgos med yin par gtan la phob// nang lus la chags shing zhen pa'i dus// cis kyang 'jig pa'i rang bzhin de// phung po gzan du skyur la thong*// bla med byang chub bsgrub pa'i rgyags// yod pa'i dus su bag med spangs// med pa'i dus su 'dod sred spangs// gong ma'i dka' spyad dran par bya// khams kyi lcogs na g.yeng ba spangs// mi lcogs dus na brtson 'grus spangs// lus ni bya ba kun dang bral// smra bsam brjod med ngang la bzhag /'chi ba mi rtag rgyud bskul zhing*// yang yang 'khor ba'i nyes mig dran// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gzhi bzung zhing*// tha mal zhen pa spang ba'i phyir// bskyed rim gsal stong 'dzin med dran// byin brlabs sems la 'jug pa'i phyir// bka' rgyud bla ma thams cad la// mos gus bskyed cing gsol ba thob// sems nyid ma bcos ngang la zhog /dge rtsa sems can don phyir bsngo// phyag chen don du gnyer ba yi// gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa ni// 'khor 'das rtsa ba rang gi sems// sems zhes bya ba'i ngo bo de// dngos po kha dog dbyibs las 'das// rig pa brtag na nam mkha' 'dra// sems dang nam mkha' gcig du chod// de don rtogs pa lta ba yin// cig char ba yi gang zag la// de don mngon gyur 'bras bu yin// gzhi lam 'bras bu gcig tu rdzogs// dbang po yang rab dkon pas na// lta ba gzhi la sgom pa lam// sgom pa lam mchog ma bgrod na// lta ba rtogs pa gzhi la lus// 'bras bu 'dod pa yid smon yin// gegs sel bogs 'don bstan pa ni// 'byung ba sa shas che ba dang*// gnas dang kha zas rkyen dbang gis// rig pa bying 'thibs dbyung ba'i dus// rig pa gzings bstod ngar dang bcas// bka' rgyud bla ma thams cad la// mos gus bskyed cing gsol ba btab// de bzhin gshegs pa'i lta stangs kyis// gsal stong nam mkha'i ngang du bzhag

/yang 'byung ba rlung shas che ba dang*// gnas dang kha zas rkyen dbang gis// rig pa 'phro rgod 'byung ba'i dus// lus ngag yid gsum klod byas la// shigs kyis bzhag la 'bol gyis bzhag /nyan thos zhi ba'i lta stangs kyis// g.yo 'gul med pa'i ngang la bzhag /de bzhin 'bad kyang ma phan na// rig pa dwangs snyigs mi 'byed cing*// ting 'dzin 'dod pa ma byung na// yang na sems kyi gzhi rtsa chod// yang na rig pa gcud la bor// yang na sgom pa'i blo dang phrol// sgom bya sgom byed phyal gyis bor// rig pa rten med shigs kyis thong*// de ltar tshul bzhin nyams blangs na// gsal stong 'dzin med ting 'dzin la// rgyun chad med par rang dbang thob// spyod lam bzhi la 'phel 'grib med// skad cig 'bral ba med pas na// rtse cig bya ba 'di rang yin// rig pa mtha' dbus med pa la// spros bral rtogs pa 'di rang yin// snang srid 'khor 'das gcig tu go /ro mnyam rtogs pa 'di rang yin// sgom byed rig pa rten dang bral// sgom med kyi 'bras bu 'di rang yin// rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa yang*// rtogs pa gcig gi nang du rdzogs// snyam pa'i nges shes yang yang skye// nges shes skyes kyang mi brtan pas// nyams yin rtogs pa ma yin te// mi sgom bar du blo mi bde// don la nyams la rtse cig yin// de yang nyams len myu gu yin// nyams len des kyang rkyen mi thub// da rung sgom la goms pa gces// de la goms shing 'dris pa dang*// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar bzhin// rang sems 'khor 'das gcig tu rtogs// rtogs pa gsal 'grib med pa de// de la ro gcig rtogs pa zer// de la brtan zhing goms pa dang*// tha mal shes pa rang lugs de// rin chen gser gling phyin pa bzhin// sgom bya sgom byed gnyis dang bral// re dogs spang blangs tha dad med// de la sgom med 'bras bu zer// rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa dag

/de ltar rtogs pa mngon gyur na// phyi rtags gzhan snang dag pa dang*// nang rtags gzung 'dzin kun las grol// gsang rtags mkha' 'gros mchod pa dang*// sems can smin cing grol ba rnams// 'ong bar 'gyur la the tshom med// ri khrod 'grim pa'i sgom chen rnams// de bzhin nyams su ma blangs na// g.yeng ba ma spangs dgon pa de// gangs kar rtse yang grong gseb yin// nyams su ma blangs dngos grub de// thob pa byas kyang yid smon tsam// nyams len med pa'i gegs sel rnams// bstan kyang sa stong yur ma yin// nyams su ma blangs lta ba de// mkhas kyang rang rgyud tha mal yin// des na tshul bzhin nyams len gces// lta sgom ngo sprod gegs sel dang*// rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa rnams// de ltar tshul bzhin nyams blangs na// dgon pa tshong 'dus bas mtha' rnams// dbyer med gcig tu rtogs pa dang*// 'bras bu thob pa the tshom med// 'bring gi ri khrod 'grims lugs so// gzhan yang skal ldan gang zag gis// gcod kyi nyams len 'di ltar mdzod// dur khrod gnyan sa phyi'i gnas// lus nad gdon gnyan nang gi gnyan// sems 'khor 'das gnyan sa gsang ba'i gnas// kun gzhi mtha' bral yongs kyi gnas// yul snang 'khrul pa phyi'i bdud// gzung 'dzin rtog pa nang gi bdud// chags sdang 'khri ba gsang ba'i bdud// kun gzhi ma rig sems kyi bdud// blos byas stong pa phyi'i bdud// sems 'dzin bogs med nang gi bdud// nyams rtogs rlom pa gsang ba'i bdud// mnyam rjes blang dor don gyi bdud// yul snang 'khrul pa sems su gcod// sems gnyis med spros bral ngang du gcod// 'gag med 'khor 'das gcig du gcod// kun gzhi ma bcos dbyings su gcod// phyi rnam rtog 'gag med sems su gcod// sems byar med blo 'das ngang du gcod// blo 'das yum chen klong du rdzogs// gcod gnyan sa 'grims na de la mdzod// 'bring gi ri khrod 'grims lugs so// rab kyi ri khrod 'grims lugs ni// tshe rabs sbyangs pa sngon song zhing*// theg chen sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa// gcig char ba'i gang zag gis// phung po khams dang skye mched la// dbu ma la sogs rtsa chen gsum// bde chen la sogs 'khor lo lnga// rtsa chen sum brgya drug cu dang*// rtsa phran brgyad khri bzhi stong dang*// ming du gtogs pa'i rtsa lnga dang*// grangs chen rtsa dang grangs med rtsa// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le rnams// sku lnga dang ni ye shes lnga// chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong dang*// mtshan bzang dpe byad brgyad cu dang*// he ru ka lnga yum lnga dang*// dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma// phung po khams dang skye mched la// gdod nas lhun gyis grub par gnas// phyi'i dur khrod gnas brgyad dang*// nang gi dur khrod gnas brgyad rnams// gcig du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// gar gnas lus bde sems dben zhing*// spyod lam ji snyed phyag dang gar// thams cad chos nyid rol pa'i phyir// gang na gnas kyang gzhal yas khang*// rang snang bde chen dag pa'i phyir// gang dang 'grogs kyang yi dam lha// grags stong bsnyen pa thengs pa'i phyir// sgra ji snyed bzlas brjod snying po'i don// khams kyi kha zas ji snyed pa// rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi// tshogs kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bskor// tshogs 'khor mdzad na de la mdzod// gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro// reg bya la sogs ji snyed pa// nang 'dod yon lnga'i lha mo yis// khams rang bzhin dag pa'i lha tshogs la// rgyun chad med par mchod pa 'bul// dngos sam yid kyi sprul pa dang*// rgyu bzhi'i ngo bo dga' ba bzhi// dga' ba mchog dga' dga' bral dang*// lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o// bde stong lhun grub mchod pa yis// khams rang bzhin lha tshogs rtag tu mnyes// tshogs rdzogs par 'dod na de la mdzod// nyon mongs ma spangs ye shes lnga// gzhi yongs su bsgyur ba'i bzhed lugs yin// 'di theg chen sngags kyi spyod yul yin// gzhi yongs su bsgyur ba de la bzhed// rnal 'byor rnams kyi nyams len yin// gang rtogs pa rnams kyi spyod yul yin// gzhi yongs su shes pa'i don rtogs shing*// gnas lugs mngon gyur rnal 'byor pa// dbang po ya rab kyi blo ngo la// don gyi bsdus so rang gi sems// mtha' dang bral ba'i lta ba dang*// rgyun chad med pa'i sgom pa dang*// dgag sgrub med pa'i spyod pa dang*// re dogs med pa'i 'bras bu bzhi// gcig tu rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// thams cad sku gsum ye shes lnga// sku gsum la yang rnam pa gsum// sems gdod nas dag pa chos kyi sku// ngag grags stong 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs// lus spyod lam sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku// de'i dbye ba gang zhe na// sems 'od gsal chen po chos kyi sku// 'du bral med pa longs spyod rdzogs// dran rtog 'gag med sprul pa'i sku// sems chos kyi sku'i sku gsum yin// ngag smra bsam brjod med chos kyi sku// sgra grags stong 'dzin med longs spyod rdzogs// dbugs 'gro 'ong sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku// ngag dag pa longs sku'i sku gsum yin// lus bya bral mnyam bzhag chos kyi sku// spyod lam 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs// bsgul bskyod sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku// lus dag pa sprul sku'i sku gsum yin// gnas lugs sgom pa'i sgom chen rnams// sku gsum ngo sprod de la mdzod// sku gsum zhing khams gang zhe na// kun gzhi mtha' bral dbu ma'i don// chos kyi sku yi zhing khams yin// sems 'gyur med bde ba chen po 'di// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing khams yin// sems 'od gsal rgyun chad med pa de// sprul pa'i sku'i zhing khams yin// khyod ri khrod 'grim pa'i sgom chen rnams// zhing khams bgrod na de la mdzod// gnas lugs don rtogs rnal 'byor pas// gzugs kyi phung po rang sar dag

/'og min gnas mchog lhun gyis grub// 'gyur med chos dbyings ye shes gnas// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rnam snang la sogs longs sku'i rigs// grub gnas tshol na de la mdzod// rnam shes phung po rang sar dag /mngon dga'i zhing khams lhun gyis grub// sems gsal stong me long ye shes gnas// mi bskyod la sogs thugs kyi rigs// grub gnas tshol na de la mdzod// tshor ba'i phung po rang sar dag /dpal ldan zhing khams lhun gyis grub// dbyer med mnyam nyid ye shes gnas// rin 'byung la sogs yon tan rigs// grub gnas tshal na de la mdzod// 'du shes phung po rang sar dag /bde ba can zhes lhun gyis grub// sems bde stong kun rtog ye shes gnas// gsung gi lha tshogs thams cad kyi// grub gnas tshol na de la mdzod// 'du byed phung po rang sar dag /rnam dag zhing khams lhun gyis grub// sems dbyer med bya grub ye shes gnas// 'phrin las grub gnas de la mdzod// dben sar bgrod pa'i bsgom chen rnams// grub gnas 'dod na de la mdzod// rtogs pa mngon gyur ji lta ba// gzhan rgyud mkhyen pa ji snyed pa// mkhyen gnyis sku gsum ye shes lnga// rang sems yin par ma rtogs par// gzhan du tshol 'dod yid smon yin// sku gsum rgyal ba'i zhing khams rnams// rang la tshang ba ma rtogs par// phyi rol 'dod pa yid smon yin// gzhi ma bcos lhun grub kun bzang la// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo rdzogs// kun gzhi bdag nyid chen po'i ngang*// 'khor 'das ma lus de la rdzogs// 'gyur med bde ba chen po la// rtsol sgrub skyon yon thams cad rdzogs// sems skye med blo 'das chos sku la// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yon tan ma lus de la rdzogs// rtsol bral lhun grub ngo mtshar che// rdzogs chen nyams len de la mdzod// rab kyi ri khrod 'drims lugs lags// gnas mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa yi// mchog thun mong dngos grub thob pa'i gnas// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas// skal ldan 'bras bu smin pa'i sa// phyi nang 'tshe ba med pa yi// shin tu dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i// tshe rabs smon lam 'brel pa yi// rnal 'byor dpon slob 'tshogs pa yi// gnas lugs nyams su len ba'i dus su// sgom chen rin bsod dbu mdzad kyi// mched grogs bu slob thams cad kyis// nyams myongs nges shes phul nas kyang*// ngo sprod bogs 'don gegs sel rnams// nan tan chen pos yang yang zhus/

ma ha mu dra'i rnal 'byor pas// kun gzhi'i thog tu blo sbyangs nas// nyams myong thog tu lta ba byas// rtogs pa ye shes sgron me yis// log rtog 'khrul pa rab bsal nas// rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i mtshan nyid dang*// 'chi ba mi rtag rgyud bskul zhing*// kun 'byung 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang*// las can phyi ma don gnyer gyis// g.yeng med bsgrub pa'i bsgrub pa'i bskur la// spro ba bskyed cing yid rangs dang*// gang zag rab 'bring rnams gsum gyi// chos dang gnas kyi mtshan nyid dang*// ngo sprod bogs 'don gegs sel dang*// gnas lugs gsal byed sgron me brtsams// de las byung ba'i bsod nams dang*/ rtogs pa mkha' ltar dag pa yi// thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis// sangs rgyas bstan pa gsal byed cing*// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yis// phrin las rgyun chad med par shog /rjes 'jug bsgrub brgyud 'dzin pa yis// bka' brgyud rnam thar rab spyod nas// bstan la bar chad med pa dang*// 'bras bu mthar phyin gdul bya yi// 'phrin las 'gran zla med pa yi// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ngang la 'god par shog /gnas bdag dge bsnyen chen po dang*// bsgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad pa yi// snang srid yid kyi gzugs can rnams// bla med byang chub thob par shog / ༈ gnas lugs gsal byed ye shes sgron me zhes bya ba/ ma ha mu dra'i rnal 'byor pas// sgom chen ri pa rnams kyi don du mdzad pa'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar rang sems sangs rgyas nyid du shog /phyi ma don du gnyer ba rnams kyis/ bstan chos 'di'i don la yang yang ltos zhing*/ sems la zhu gtugs mdzad par zhu/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa yang yang dran zhing 'jig rten 'di rmi lam 'am sgyu ma lta bur phyal gyis bor ba dang*/ yengs ba med pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ mos gus chen pos nyams su len par zhu/

bdud kyi las thams cad spongs zhing*/ nyams len la phyi dus med par mdzod/ ri khrod dgon par rtag tu sdod cing*/ nyams len la goms par mdzod/ gegs sel dang bogs 'don yang rang rang gi rgyud tshod dang sbyar zhing nan tan mdzod/ 'di ltar tshul bzhin nyams su mi blang bar yig cung mang po snod du bsogs nas/ yang yang mjal grangs mang pos gsal 'debs gcig zhu zer ba nyams len la bogs mi thon zhing*/ rtogs pa mngon du gyur dka' bas na/ rtogs pa goms zhing brtan par mdzod/ thos pa dang go yul tsam la brten nas gzhan rgyud shes pa ci tsug byas kyang*/ rang rgyud tha mal du 'dug pas nyams la brtan par mdzod/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams rgyud la ma skyes par/ rang bsgoms chen pa bzang po yin snyam nas gzhan la zhe brnyas dang khyad gsod byas na/ rang rgyud la sgrib pa bsogs pas/ rang gi dman sa bzung zhing*/ gzhan la bkur bar mdzod/ sbyangs pa'i las 'phro can su yin tshod mi zin pas/ las dang po pa dang su la yang brnyas pa'i bya ba thams cad spang bar mdzod/ nyams len bya snyam pa'i blo yod kyang da bya sang bya'i g.yeng bas ma khyer bar mdzod/ gzhan gyis sangs rgyas yin zer yang*/ rang 'chi khar mi 'tsher ba la mi phan pas/ rang nyams rtogs kyi gdeng dang ldan par mdzod/ las dang po pa la ci smras pa thams cad yon tan can la bzod par gsol/ 'jig rten rong bzhi mtha' 'khob gnas// mya ngan gyi khang pa nag po yin// dus da res thar yang phyi ma lus// sems mtha' bral chen po lta ba'i rong*// de ma yengs gnas pa sgom pa'i rong*// rgyun chad med pa spyod pa'i rong*// lhun gyis grub pa 'bras bu'i rong*// rong de la 'bros na rtag tu thar// don de la soms la rong 'bros// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon sbyangs las 'phro ldan pa yi// skyes bu bsgrubs la gzhol ba rnams// nyams len gnad 'di go bar gyis// dmigs bcas 'bad pa du ma yis// dmigs med 'od gsal rtogs pa'i thabs// las dang po pa'i gang zag la// gnas cha yod kyang gsal cha med// de phyir sgo lnga'i shes pa 'di// ma 'gag ngo bo nyid la ltos// las dang po pa yi gang zag la// gsal cha yod kyang bde cha med// des na yul sems snang ba 'di// bde ba'i rol char khyer cig ang*// las dang po pa yi gang zag la// bde cha yod kyang stong cha med// des na dga' bzhi'i ngo bo de// skye med stong pa rgya yis thob// gsum ka yod pa'i rnal 'byor kyang*// dran pa'i thag pas ma bzung na// rgyu mthun gyi bag chags sbyangs dka' bas// yengs ba med pa'i dran pas zung*// thams cad 'bral med yod lags kyang*// bsam gtan rtsal sbyongs ma byas na// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mi 'char bas// lta stangs bye brag 'bongs la sbyongs// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thob lags kyang*// thabs mkhas snying rjes ma sbyangs na// gzhan don 'phrin las mi 'byung bas// bsdu ba rnam bzhi phul du phyungs// de ltar 'bad pa mthar thugs su// rgyal sras kun gyis rab rtogs pa// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa rnams// rten cing 'brel 'byung chos can no// de la der 'dzin rab dag pa// rtogs pa 'di ni stong nyid bzod// kun la rgya yis btab pa ni// phyag rgya chen po zhes bya'o// de 'dra'i don de rab rtogs nas// mthar thug gzhan don bsgrub par byos// bzod pa gtan la phab pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/

rta lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu dgu la/ rang byung rdo rjes lha stengs zhes bya ba'i ri khrod du/ tsa ri'i grwa pa sgom chen pa rnams la gsungs pa'o/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// /
